svg.title: Auto router strategies
svg.desc: Eight animated tiles show how the auto router picks a candidate. Each tile groups aliases and highlights an example pick. Nadir and decision fall back to rules when a decider cannot be used.
svg.text: One tile per strategy with aliases grouped · green outline = example pick
